fn run(xs: List[Int], acc: Int) -> Int
  requires (acc >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((len(xs) > 0) or (result == acc))
  effects pure

  example (run([-5, 2], 0) == 2)
  example (run([10, -3, -20, 5], 0) == 12)
{
  match xs { [] => acc [h, ..t] => run(t, step(acc, h)) }
}

  run(xs, 0)

fn has(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == contains(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (has([1, 4, 6], 4) == true)
  example (has([1, 4, 6], 5) == false)
  example (has([], 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == x) or has(t, x)) }
}

fn nth_is(xs: List[Int], i: Int, x: Int) -> Bool
  requires (i >= 0)
  ensures (result == ((i < len(xs)) and (xs[i] == x)))
  effects pure
  example (nth_is([1, 4, 6], 1, 4) == true)
  example (nth_is([1, 4, 6], 1, 5) == false)
  example (nth_is([1, 4, 6], 3, 6) == false)
  example (nth_is([], 0, 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => if (i == 0) then (h == x) else nth_is(t, (i - 1), x) }
}

fn valid_result(xs: List[Int], x: Int, r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (((not result) or (r != None)) or (not contains(xs, x)))
  ensures (((not result) or (r == None)) or contains(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (valid_result([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, Some(2)) == true)
  example (valid_result([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, Some(1)) == false)
  example (valid_result([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, None) == false)
  example (valid_result([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, None) == true)
  example (valid_result([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, Some(0)) == false)
{
  match r { None => not has(xs, x) Some(i) => ((i >= 0) and nth_is(xs, i, x)) }
}

fn scan(xs: List[Int], x: Int, i: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires ((i >= 0) and sorted(xs))
  ensures ((result == None) or contains(xs, x))
  ensures ((result != None) or (not contains(xs, x)))
  effects pure
  example (scan([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, 0) == Some(2))
  example (scan([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, 0) == None)
  example (scan([], 3, 0) == None)
  example (scan([1, 4, 6, 9], 1, 0) == Some(0))
  example (scan([1, 4, 6, 9], 9, 0) == Some(3))
{
  match xs { [] => None [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then Some(i) else if (h > x) then None else scan(t, x, (i + 1)) }
}

fn binary_search(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires (sorted(xs) and distinct(xs))
  ensures valid_result(xs, x, result)
  effects pure
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 6) == Some(2))
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 5) == None)
  example (binary_search([], 3) == None)
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 1) == Some(0))
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 9) == Some(3))
{
  scan(xs, x, 0)
}

fn greater(xs: List[Int], t: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures forall x in result: (x > t)
  ensures forall x in xs: ((x <= t) or (count(result, x) == count(xs, x)))
  ensures (len(result) <= len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (greater([1, 5, 3, 8], 3) == [5, 8])
  example (greater([], 0) == [])
  example (greater([3, 3], 3) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..r] => if (h > t) then ([h] ++ greater(r, t)) else greater(r, t) }
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == len(greater(xs, t)))

  example (tally([-1, 0, 1], -5) == 3)

  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..r] => if (h > t) then (1 + tally(r, t)) else tally(r, t) }

fn evens(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures forall x in result: ((x % 2) == 0)
  ensures forall x in xs: (count(result, x) == (if ((x % 2) == 0) then count(xs, x) else 0))
  effects pure
  example (evens([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [2, 4])
  example (evens([]) == [])
  example (evens([5, 7]) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if ((h % 2) == 0) then ([h] ++ evens(t)) else evens(t) }
}

fn odds(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)

  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if ((h % 2) != 0) then ([h] ++ odds(t)) else odds(t) }

  (evens(xs) ++ odds(xs))

}

fn count_less(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures ((result == 0) == (forall x in xs: (x >= v)))
  ensures ((result == len(xs)) == (forall x in xs: (x < v)))
  effects pure
  example (count_less([5, 1, 3], 3) == 1)
  example (count_less([5, 1, 3], 1) == 0)
  example (count_less([5, 1, 3], 9) == 3)
  example (count_less([], 4) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h < v) then (1 + count_less(t, v)) else count_less(t, v) }
}

fn length(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (length([5, 1, 3]) == 3)
  example (length([]) == 0)
  example (length([8]) == 1)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => (1 + length(t)) }
}

fn pick(cands: List[Int], xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires (len(cands) >= 1)
  requires exists c in cands: (count_less(xs, c) == k)
  ensures contains(cands, result)
  ensures (count_less(xs, result) == k)
  effects pure
  example (pick([5, 1, 3], [5, 1, 3], 1) == 3)
  example (pick([9, 2, 7, 4, 6], [9, 2, 7, 4, 6], 2) == 6)
  example (pick([8], [8], 0) == 8)
{
  match cands { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (count_less(xs, h) == k) then h else pick(t, xs, k) }
}

fn median_odd(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires ((len(xs) % 2) == 1)
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures (count_less(xs, result) == (len(xs) / 2))
  effects pure
  example (median_odd([5, 1, 3]) == 3)
  example (median_odd([8]) == 8)
  example (median_odd([9, 2, 7, 4, 6]) == 6)
{
  pick(xs, xs, (length(xs) / 2))
}

  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): (((xs[i] == a) and (result[i] == b)) or ((xs[i] != a) and (result[i] == xs[i])))
  effects pure

{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([if (h == a) then b else h] ++ replace_all(t, a, b)) }
}
